about: The mutant ledger of cmd/ergo, started by R3b (wf10, 2026-11-10). Each mutant names the rule it breaks and the test that kills it. The R3b judge runs the killer with go test -run in ./cmd/ergo.

mutants.name: e5-fatal
mutants.rule: A defect keeps status 2 and stops later packages, rather than becoming an ordinary failed law.

mutants.name: e5-empty
mutants.rule: An empty recursive selection is an error, never a green run with nothing tested.

mutants.name: e5-pattern
mutants.rule: check and test accept a recursive package pattern.

mutants.name: e5-roots
mutants.rule: Every selected package, not just the first root, runs.

mutants.name: e5-order
mutants.rule: Dependencies run before their dependents, independent of folder name order.

mutants.name: e5-status
mutants.rule: One failed law makes the module command exit 1.

mutants.name: e5-continue
mutants.rule: A failed law does not hide the tests of later packages.

mutants.name: e5-nested
mutants.rule: A nested module is outside the selected module.

mutants.name: e5-fmt
mutants.rule: fmt accepts the same recursive module pattern without checking types.

mutants.name: r3b-spell
mutants.rule: ergo gen rpc names the contract by its resolved import path, never by how the command spelled the folder; --check from any spelling finds current files current.
